# carousel-cards provenance

- Upstream: https://github.com/crealwork/carousel-cards
- Reviewed commit: `ba0c7c1976d06acf866487b300258dd24979a0f5`
- License: MIT (`LICENSE`)
- Reviewed: 2026-10-31

Ethos does not install or execute the upstream skill. The existing legal Source Lock, brand frame, JSON contract, Chromium renderer, and QA remain authoritative.

Adapted ideas:

- avoid adjacent reuse of the same eligible layout;
- inspect the deck as thumbnail silhouettes, not only full-size cards;
- retain a safe flex-centering fallback on newly generated automatic drafts so tall content starts at the top instead of clipping upward;
- record the selected automatic archetype in HTML for review.

Not adopted:

- automatic research, hooks, success stories, statistics, or CTA generation;
- fixed 1080×1350 output and upstream typography sizes;
- external CDN fonts, browser download libraries, and upstream publishing flow;
- layout quotas that would force unsupported charts, quotations, examples, or claims.
